justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/core/JITWatchConfig.java, ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/sandbox/Sandbox.java, ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/sandbox/SandboxConfigStage.java, and core/src/test/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/test/TestJITWatchConfig.java. The enum is a small 3-state config mode loaded/saved only inside JITWatchConfig and referenced by just two production classes (sandbox command-line generation and sandbox config UI) plus one test file, so the fan-in/fan-out is limited and does not show hub-like modularization.
